'''Ista Kezever''' was a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Kezever published an article in the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' about the repair of [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]] called "[[The Broken Viewscreen, or How to Save a Picture Forever]]."<ref name="BV" /> Ista Kezever also published the article "[[Galaxy in Review ... Intergalactic Report 12.1]]" in the ''[[Naboo Herald]]'' about changes in politics and technology.<ref name="SWG:12.1">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Loading Screen: Publish 12.1</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
When the developers of the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' released the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes: 25 January 05|Publish 12.1]]" update on [[January 25]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> a loading screen styled as a news article written by Ista Kezever was shown to all players of the game, describing various changes to the game in an [[in-universe]] style.<ref name="SWG:12.1" /> Ista Kezever is also credited as the author of "The Broken Viewscreen, or How to Save a Picture Forever," a guide published on the official ''Star Wars Galaxies'' website that explained how players could combine various looted items to create posters and paintings.<ref name="BV" />
